notes:
Inbound from support-automation vendor community. Team sold RelayCove as a packaged helpdesk + automation layer — wants to augment with LLM-driven ticket summarization and actionable structured output to push to their workflow.

Highlights / quotes:
- "We want to auto-create 3-line summaries for CS reps and structured JSON outputs to drive routing rules." (CTO)
- Interested in tool-calling: run a query against their internal ticket DB, then push action via webhook.
- Signed up self-serve on site, created API key and ran quick tests (small sample).

Technical notes / asks:
- Prefer hosted API for speed to market (self-serve trial).
- Needs structured output + schema validation for downstream automation. Example fields: severity, suggested-tag, SLA-risk (low/med/high), follow_up_actions[].
- Latency SLO: p95 < 350ms for short summaries (~150 tokens).
- Throughput: 50-200 reqs/min during peak — cost-sensitive; wants guidance on batching and prefix caching.
- Model preference: open weights ok but wants Redwood catalog recommendation for low-cost summarization model.

Procurement / security:
- Procurement requested SOC2 evidence and audit log samples. Mentioned KMS for key management.
- Data residency not critical now (US-only), but may need EU later.

Sales notes / tone:
- Early technical champion: eng lead (Aisha Kumar). Business champion: Head of CS (Ben Ortiz) — cares about time-to-resolution and rep adoption.
- Good fit for PLG path; likely SMB paid conversion if POC shows token economics < $0.10/ticket on avg.

References / artifacts:
- Drive: quick POC spec + sample prompts (drive://relaycove/Redwood-quickstart-v1)
